title.en: Expectation, joint distributions, covariance, and dependence
title.zh: 期望、联合分布、协方差与依赖关系

lead.en: Calculate exact joint moments and costs, prove expectation and conditional-variance identities, diagnose nonlinear uncorrelated dependence, and connect optional covariance geometry to centred PCA.
lead.zh: 算精确联合矩与成本，证期望及条件方差恒等式，诊断非线性不相关依赖，连接选学协方差几何与中心PCA。

prerequisites.en: Module 22 for every route; Module 17 for continuous integrals. The optional vector-covariance extension uses Module 12, and the optional PCA connection revisits Module 14. All labs use the standard library.
prerequisites.zh: 所有路线需模块 22，连续积分需模块 17。选学向量Cov用模块 12，PCA回顾模块 14。全部实验标准库。

en: Compute weighted and function expectations with integrability and target-population checks.
Derive variance, scaling and moment-existence distinctions.
Construct joint, marginal and positive-case conditional distributions.
Prove covariance sum identities and disprove zero-correlation independence claims.
Derive total expectation, total variance and squared-risk conditional-mean optimality.
AI extension: prove covariance PSD and transformation, qualify Gaussian independence, and connect centred PCA to variance.
zh: 按可积与目标检查算加权及函数期望。
推方差、尺度与矩存在区别。
构造联合、边缘及正情况条件。
证Cov和式，反驳零相关独立。
推全期望、全方差及平方风险条件均值最优。
AI证Cov PSD与变换，限定Gaussian独立，连接中心PCA与方差。

plotAlt.en: Two scatter plots compare the exact square relation Y=X squared with an independent uniform reference; both sample covariances are small, while only the first lies on a parabola.
plotAlt.zh: 两个散点比较精确平方关系与独立均匀参考；两样本Cov小，但仅首图落在抛物线。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and derive weighted costs and moments.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，推加权成本与矩。
阅读线性与有限矩假设。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and derive the joint-table summaries.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，推联合表摘要。

text.en: Compute exact moments and conditional decompositions.
Read Sections 5–6; CS practises finite conditional cases, AI adds covariance geometry.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节；CS练有限条件，AI加Cov几何。

text.en: Compare nonlinear dependence and independent-reference scatter.
text.zh: 比较非线性依赖与独立散点。

text.en: Complete application Exercises 8–10 with the route alternative.

title.zh: 依赖诊断与完整恒等式

text.en: Repair the variance shortcut and inspect the applicable geometry extension.
text.zh: 修方差捷径，查适用几何扩展。

text.en: Complete choices and the written conditional decomposition.
text.zh: 完成选择及书面条件分解。

text.en: Read conditional expectation and covariance limitations.
Complete the exit task and audit joint assumptions.
text.zh: 完成结业，核查联合假设。
